#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <vector>

using mod_t = long long;

mod_t modPow(mod_t base, mod_t exp, mod_t mod) {
    mod_t result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

mod_t modInverse(mod_t a, mod_t mod) {
    return modPow(a, mod - 2, mod);
}

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    std::cin >> n;

    std::vector<std::vector<mod_t>> p(n, std::vector<mod_t>(n));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            int v;
            std::cin >> v;
            p[i][j] = (mod_t)v * modInverse(100, 1000000007) % 1000000007;
        }
    }

    mod_t MOD = 1000000007;
    std::vector<mod_t> dp(1 << n, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        int i = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        if (i >= n) continue;
        
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (mask & (1 << j)) continue;
            int newMask = mask | (1 << j);
            dp[newMask] = (dp[newMask] + dp[mask] * p[i][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    std::cout << dp[(1 << n) - 1] << '\n';
    return 0;
}
